factualFollowups.actualQuestion:
What prompted the CRM search, how many people will use it, and what monthly budget do you have in mind?

Which tools or workflows must it support—for example, Gmail or Outlook, prospecting, calling, lead routing, or forecasting?
factualFollowups.actualReply: Three seats; target maximum USD 180/month total, month-to-month preferred. Google Workspace email, shared spreadsheets and PDF quotes; three people handle sales. We need a usable inbox/activity history, follow-up ownership, organization/contact relationships, CSV import, and an exit path that includes notes and attached quotes. No sales automation or bulk sending is required to start.
factualFollowups.sourcePolicy: Reply only with responsive facts from the frozen synthetic source packet. No new subjective decisions, computed answers or approvals.

factualFollowups.actualQuestion:
The sales notes mention firms with several locations and contacts shared across locations. Do locations need their own lasting records, or would a location field on each sales opportunity be enough?
- Keep separate location records and shared-contact links
- A location field on each opportunity is enough
- Not sure—recommend an approach
factualFollowups.actualReply: Organizations, locations, contacts, notes and attached quotes must survive migration and an eventual export. A property management firm can own several locations, and a contact may work for more than one location. Losing that relationship during import or export would be expensive.
factualFollowups.sourcePolicy: Reply only with responsive facts from the frozen synthetic source packet. No new subjective decisions, computed answers or approvals.
factualFollowups.scope: Existing organization/location/contact preservation requirement; no new schema choice supplied.

factualFollowups.actualQuestion:
How many people will use the CRM, how do you sell (for example, self-serve, outbound, or longer enterprise deals), and what’s your approximate budget?

What’s prompting the CRM search, and which tools or integrations must it work with?
factualFollowups.actualReply: Three seats; target maximum USD 180/month total, month-to-month preferred. Google Workspace email, shared spreadsheets and PDF quotes; three people handle sales. The founder, one salesperson and the support lead all work from a shared spreadsheet. A weekly call goes row by row through opportunities. Quotes live as PDF files linked from the sheet. Additional information about the sales model and trigger is not available.

redactionNotes: All five fictional inputs per arm and all three control-created files retain exact bytes. UM produced no artifact, and none is added on its behalf.
